content:
marta: Quick heads-up — int4 bring-up for rwd-v6 showing a sharp regression on one slice. Landing traffic at 5% but 'billing-clerical' dropped ~18% exact-match in A/B (small but loud). attaching quick numbers below.
liam: link? :eyes:
sylvia: can you paste slice definition and the A/B counts? small-N slices can be noisy.
marta: slice = queries containing /invoice|statement|due date/ AND tokens < 30. sample_n=4,200 in AB window. offline eval: baseline MRR 0.120 -> int4 0.098 (delta -0.022). hallucination rate (factual contradiction) baseline 0.7% -> 2.3% (abs +1.6%). latency p95 +4ms. traffic we sent: 5% uniform.
anil: ouch. that hallucination jump is concerning even if it's a narrow slice.
liam: do we have the canary config? what autofallback thresholds did we set for model-promote? we should be explicit for 'knockout' slices.
marta: current rollout config (excerpt):
```
rollout:
  initial_pct: 5
  evaluation_window: 30m
  thresholds:
    mrr_delta_allow: -0.02   # bottom-line relative
    hallucination_abs_allow: 0.01
  auto_fallback: true
  min_cohort_samples: 1000
```
(I know this is pretty generic — didn't expect the big jump on this cohort.)
sylvia: two quick suggestions: 1) add a propensity-weighted watchlist so high-propensity cohorts get stricter bounds; 2) add a "knockout" rule: if cohort sample_n > 2k AND hallucination_abs_delta > 1% AND mrr_delta < -0.015 => immediate cutoff for that cohort (route to baseline). also hysteresis: require condition hold for 3 consecutive evaluation windows to avoid flapping.
anil: agree. for propensity weighting, compute weight = cohort_propensity / global_propensity. treat weight>2 as high-risk. then scale mrr_allow = base_allow / weight.
liam: concrete numbers proposal: knockout if sample_n >=2000 AND (mrr_delta <= -0.015 OR hallucination_abs_delta >= 0.01). For auto-fallback we mark cohort as "watchlist:knockout" and set cohort_pct=0 for new model while keeping overall promote on other cohorts.
sylvia: note: watch for oscillation when traffic is bursty (billing API calls spike). hysteresis: require 3 windows or 90s stable signal before marking permanent. also add a soft-penalty to total-promote score so one knockout cohort doesn't immediately block global promote unless it's high-weighted.
deploy-bot: canary-started model=rwd-v6-int4 pct=5 env=staging ts=6632104350
marta: i'm going to patch the rollout YAML with the knockout rule + propensity weighting and run a 10k-request shadow for that slice (shadow only, no traffic shift) to see if signal persists. will share raw diffs + small-sample eval table.
liam: thank you. if shadow shows <0.5% MRR delta and hallucination delta <0.3% absolute we can consider staged promote. otherwise we keep the knockout watchlist and block cohort traffic. :thumbsup:
